prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right choice depends on your goals, budget, industry and culture fit. That said, Kansas City has several highly regarded agencies you should consider:

- Barkley — large, full-service creative agency known for brand strategy, advertising and integrated campaigns.  
- VML / VMLY&R — global digital and experience agency with strong capabilities in digital transformation and customer experience (has deep KC roots).  
- Ologie — KC-based agency focused on digital marketing, content, analytics and strategy for midmarket and B2B clients.

How to pick the best one for you
- Define your objective: brand repositioning, lead generation, ecommerce, PR, social, etc.  
- Check industry experience and relevant case studies.  
- Evaluate size/capability fit: national/global firms vs. local boutique specialists.  
- Review measurable results (KPIs, ROI) and client references.  
- Consider budget, timeline and communication style.

Where to find more options and reviews
- Clutch.co, UpCity, and Ad Age agency lists for ratings and client reviews.  
- Local awards (AAF KC, American Advertising Awards) and LinkedIn for staff expertise.  
- Ask peers in your industry for referrals.

If you want, tell me: what industry are you in, what are your top goals and your budget range — I can shortlist 3 Kansas City agencies that match and draft an outreach/RFP email you can use.
